$comment: The design surface registry (DESIGN.md §Design toolkit). The brief guard hook, tests/design-receipts.test.ts, tests/ui and /design-gate all read this one file. status: 'legacy' (not yet through the pipeline, receipts not required), 'in-progress' (brief required before any edit, receipts not yet required), 'rebuilt' (every required receipt must exist, be fresh, and show an adopted finding). Registering a surface is how a redesign starts; a registered surface cannot be edited without its brief.
